topic: AIChE Public Affairs Town Hall - Adjusting to Federal Policy Changes
title: AIChE Public Affairs Town Hall - Adjusting to Federal Policy Changes
session_title: Adjusting to Federal Policy Changes – A PAIC Town Hall
abstract: This year has heralded sweeping policy and organizational changes in the U.S. Federal government including environmental regulation, agency organization, grant administration, programming strategy, and foreign trade management. The Public Affairs and Information Committee (PAIC) has published a series of articles in Chemical Engineering Progress providing information with perspectives for chemical engineers as new developments have unfolded. In this PAIC Town Hall, AIChE would now like to hear directly from our members in industry, academia, and government, how these changes have impacted their organizations, operations, and career paths. This will be a facilitated discussion forum intended to provide the PAIC with valuable insights to inform AIChE initiatives best serving our members and the profession.
